headline: India Weighs Halving Equity Transaction Tax and Raising F&O Levies
summary: The Indian government is reviewing a proposal to reduce the securities transaction tax on delivery equity purchases by 50% while increasing levies on derivative trades to curb retail trading losses.
why: India's equity market has seen surging retail activity in equity derivatives. Adjusting transaction taxes aims to shift volume into long-term cash equities.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Lower cash transaction costs support cash volumes while higher derivatives taxes may curb liquidity.
